dict.string: MeetingDebrief reads your calendar to know when meetings end, so it can prompt you for a summary or next step.
MeetingDebrief records your side of meetings so it can transcribe them for you (only when auto-record is enabled).
MeetingDebrief transcribes meeting recordings on-device to attach a transcript to each meeting.
MeetingDebrief captures system audio during meetings so other participants are included in the transcript.
